status: Additional configurations selected by structure and prior GS accessibility, not coefficient agreement. This plan extends existing finite-window evidence and is not a blind preregistration.
primary_status: A common finite-window estimate. Local diagnostics may fail; such estimates remain explicitly unresolved. No fit is selected by agreement with equilibrium.
screen_interpretation: An operational screen only: theta >= 4 and theta/L <= 0.05 do not prove scale separation. The narrow region is L/3 and velocity factors also matter.
protocol: Same real hopping Hamiltonian, half filling, single species natural-log Renyi2. Exact FE.evolve(theta), followed by own-empty-site exp(-2 beta) measurement. Ground-state reachability checked anew for every pattern/L. Origin (1,1), L divisible by 3m, three entropies evaluated independently, D=(2SA+SC)/3-SB. General real Cholesky entropy, no uniform-A symmetry shortcut.
coefficient_comparison: Fit equilibrium independently. Assess finite-time size, window and model changes before comparing coefficients. Model/window ranges are sensitivity ranges, not statistical confidence intervals.
fallback: Publish all 27 coefficient pairs as finite-window estimates; mark failed or missing local diagnostics. Do not force equality or infer a universal scaling theorem. Record any scientifically motivated extensions as dated revisions.
